prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental nocturnal ambient piece for quietly browsing a map of knowledge. Around 60 BPM, G Mixolydian. Soft Rhodes piano, airy analog pads, a few harp harmonics and a warm sub that barely moves. The mood is desk-lamp calm: many small facts belonging to one sky, not an epic voyage. Spacious, low-dynamics, loop-friendly. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No trailer percussion, no brass, no arpeggiator fireworks.

[00:00–00:30] Rhodes voicings alone, slow and slightly dusty, with a faint room tone.
[00:30–01:10] Airy pads bloom under the Rhodes; harp harmonics mark distant points like faint stars.
[01:10–01:55] Soft analog bass holds a pedal. Harmony tilts once toward the Mixolydian seventh, then settles.
[01:55–02:30] Thin back to Rhodes and a single pad so a loop into the opening feels natural.
